paragraphs: Yitzḥak, Rav Pappa's student, at Abba Mar's wedding—Rav Pappa's son—in the first chapter of Kiddushin. Our present reading is R. Yitzḥak bar Rav Yehudah (see above). Yuḥasin's reading seems correct; see Rav Pappa.
